verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents provisioned Team Computers that can be assigned to a single member or to a group, which gives group-based machine access. It also documents granular role-based admin roles and SCIM user provisioning. However, no shared address book or management console is described, and per-group policy controls beyond computer assignment are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a shared console or address book, per-group policy settings beyond assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Once a Team Computer is provisioned, it can be assigned to either a single team member or a group.
Create granular admin roles through role based access
